1. (Currently amended) A method comprising: a processor determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; the processor accessing a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; the processor receiving an indication from the data store that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication with respect to at least one of the payment transactions; the processor accepting the received indication as proof-of-life with respect to the recipient; and the processor making the benefit payment to the recipient in response to said proof-of-life, wherein the method includes __a technical solution implemented by the processor that improves the functioning of a computer system by automatically verifying recipient liveness through analysis of biometric authentication data stored in the data store, thereby reducing fraudulent benefit payments and improving the security and efficiency of benefit distribution systems__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said at least one payment transaction occurred during a pre-determined period of time prior to said accessing step, and __wherein the processor automatically filters the data store records to identify only those payment transactions within the pre-determined period of time__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 2, wherein said pre-determined period of time is seven days.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 2, wherein said pre-determined period of time is 24 hours.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment, and __wherein the processor is configured to process social insurance benefit distributions__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the at least one of the payment transactions includes a credit card account transaction and/or a debit card account transaction, and __wherein the processor accesses biometric authentication records associated with such payment transactions__.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6, wherein a mobile device was used by the recipient to initiate the at least one payment transaction, and __wherein the processor retrieves biometric authentication data from mobile device transaction records__.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is made via an electronic monetary transfer to an account owned by the recipient, and __wherein the processor executes the electronic monetary transfer__.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is made by sending a check to the recipient, and __wherein the processor initiates check generation and delivery__.

10. (Currently amended) A method comprising: a processor determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; the processor accessing, at a first point in time, a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; the processor determining that the data store contains an indication that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication most recently with respect to one of said payment transactions at a second point in time earlier than the first point in time; the processor comparing a time interval defined by the second and first points in time with a pre-determined permissive time interval; the processor making the benefit payment, without requiring proof-of-life authentication of the recipient, in a case where the time interval defined by the second and first points in time does not exceed the pre-determined permissive time interval; and the processor requiring proof-of-life authentication of the recipient, prior to making the benefit payment, in a case where the time interval defined by the second and first points in time exceeds the pre-determined permissive time interval, wherein the method includes __a technical solution implemented by the processor that improves the functioning of a computer system by automatically determining whether to require additional proof-of-life authentication based on a time-interval analysis of stored biometric authentication records, thereby reducing fraudulent benefit payments and improving the efficiency of benefit distribution systems__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the pre-determined permissive time interval is seven days, and __wherein the processor automatically compares the time interval against the seven-day threshold__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the pre-determined permissive time interval is 24 hours, and __wherein the processor automatically compares the time interval against the 24-hour threshold__.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment, and __wherein the processor is configured to process social insurance benefit distributions__.

14. (Currently amended) An apparatus comprising: a processor; and a memory in communication with the processor, the memory storing program instructions, the processor operative with the program instructions to perform functions as follows: determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; accessing a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; receiving an indication from the data store that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication with respect to at least one of the payment transactions; accepting the received indication as proof-of-life with respect to the recipient; and making the benefit payment to the recipient in response to said proof-of-life, wherein __the apparatus implements a technical solution that improves the functioning of a computer system by automatically verifying recipient liveness through analysis of biometric authentication data stored in the data store, thereby reducing fraudulent benefit payments and improving the security and efficiency of benefit distribution systems__.

15. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein said at least one payment transaction occurred during a pre-determined period of time prior to said accessing, and __wherein the processor automatically filters the data store records to identify only those payment transactions within the pre-determined period of time__.

16. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 15, wherein said pre-determined period of time is seven days.

17. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 15, wherein said pre-determined period of time is 24 hours.

18. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment, and __wherein the processor is configured to process social insurance benefit distributions__.

19. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein the at least one of the payment transactions includes a credit card account transaction and/or a debit card account transaction, and __wherein the processor accesses biometric authentication records associated with such payment transactions__.

20. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 19, wherein a mobile device was used by the recipient to initiate the at least one payment transaction, and __wherein the processor retrieves biometric authentication data from mobile device transaction records__.
